items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: we were going to have the quintet with Brian Lynch, Phil, and Bill Charlap, Steve Gilmore and myself.

ctx.x: I’ve often wondered about that. Sometimes you see a record where it’s a quartet except for one song that’s a trio. Like no chordal instrument. And you think, “Oh that was very experimental for them” when in fact probably the piano player just couldn’t finish.

Or really more esperential. Yeah it happens. Those are scenes where you get prepared to do a recording. I like to do live recordings a lot and there was one we were going to do in New York at a club with Phil and I had it all set up. We had a really great relationship with Bruce Lundvall in these last years when he was at Blue Note. We became very © Fillius Jazz Archive -16-

friendly over the years and I wanted to do a — we had done — I’d done some records for Bruce for Blue Note but I hadn’t done Phil’s group. I said you know we could do something with Phil. And he said that maybe that was a good idea but he didn’t know. So then we were going to do a thing at this club in New York called The Iridium and we were going to have the quintet with Brian Lynch, Phil, and Bill Charlap, Steve Gilmore and myself. We had a guest, Bob Dorough and Jon Gordon the alto player, the young alto…

items.title: Steve Gilmore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Delaware Water Gap, PA, November 8, 1999
items.q: Phil Woods came back and started to live in this very area, and he started dating Bill Goodwin’s sister... anyway that’s where we all met

ctx.x: Comedians, acts, I played for Tony Bennett, I played for all kinds of very good singers who used to come and play these resorts for the weekends. But then I did that for a while and I remember I got mad one night. It was 1967 and I was doing these resorts and stuff and I think I had a fight with a girlfriend, I broke up with a girlfriend and got really mad and quit my job and threw all my stuff into the car, which would fit in a car at that time, my bass and everything, and drove down to Miami, Florida to stay…
You played with some good people down in Florida too, right?
